questions.question: Out of the four sentences given, three have spelling errors. Identify the sentence that has no spelling error.
options: A clergyman read the litturgy from the prayer-book.
What advice did he give to young entreprenuers?
She tried to manoeuvre her trolley around people.
The computer's software detected an anamoly caused by a virus.
questions.solution:
C) The correct sentence isC. She tried to manoeuvre her trolley around people.
Litturgy → Incorrect spelling. The correct spelling is "liturgy" (a form of public worship).Entreprenuers → Incorrect spelling. The correct spelling is "entrepreneurs" (business owners).Manoeuvre → Correct spelling. This British English spelling means to move skillfully or carefully.Anamoly → Incorrect spelling. The correct spelling is "anomaly" (something unusual or unexpected).
